h1.cap: One team used every colour... the other used none. Pick your winner.

n2.cap: Rumi tells of a contest. A Sultan gives two houses... one to Chinese artists, one to Greek.

n3.cap: The Chinese gather every kind of paint... and cover their walls with wonders.

n4.cap: The Greeks "used no colours at all." They just cleaned... and polished.

q1.cap: "...burnishing them till they were as clear and bright as the heavens."

n5.cap: The Sultan inspects both. The painted house is much admired. But in the end...

q2.cap: "...the Greek house carried off the palm."

n6.cap: Their shining walls caught every colour... in endless shades.

n7.cap: In essence... what your heart truly knows beats what you only learned from books.

n8.cap: We try to grow by adding... more apps, more courses, more noise. Sometimes, we grow by clearing.

n9.cap: Painting looks like progress. Polishing looks like nothing... until the light hits.

n10.cap: This morning, remove one thing before adding anything... a tab, an app, a grudge.

n11.cap: What would you clear first? One word, below.

n12.cap: Follow Awazzzz... keep your wall clean.
